subject.title: [Feature]: /learn command — distill recent work into a reviewable skill draft

question: Should OpenClaw accept `/learn` as a built-in core chat command, rather than leaving this as existing Skill Workshop chat guidance or a plugin/ClawHub affordance?
rationale: The request fits operator ergonomics but adds a core command namespace and sits near the VISION.md boundary between lean core, skills, plugins, and ClawHub.

options.title: Approve thin core command
options.body: Accept `/learn` in core after the linked PR resolves proof and compatibility review, preserving the existing proposal and approval gates.

options.title: Keep as documented workflow
options.body: Do not add a new command and instead improve docs/help around asking the agent to create a Skill Workshop proposal from recent work.

options.title: Route outside core
options.body: Ask for a plugin or ClawHub affordance if maintainers do not want another built-in command surface.

recommendation.title: Approve thin core command
recommendation.body: Accept `/learn` in core after the linked PR resolves proof and compatibility review, preserving the existing proposal and approval gates.

likelyOwner.reason: They opened the protected request and authored the linked implementation candidate for the command surface.
